agingInvoices.aSummaryOfOutstandingInvoices: A summary of outstanding invoices broken down into the period of which they are overdue

annualIncome.totalIncomePerMonthFor: Income received per month of the selected year: payments less refunds.

clientsByCountry.thisReportShowsTheTotal: This report shows the total number of active services per country, as well as total active unique clients per country in the table below.
clientsByCountry.mapHint: Hover a dot to see the city.

clientsReport.thisReportCanBeUsed: This report can be used to generate a custom export of clients by applying up to 5 filters. CSV Export is available via the Tools menu to the right.
clientsReport.noClientsFoundClickFilter: No clients found. Click Filter to load results.

clientStatement.thisReportProvidesAStatement: This report provides a statement of account for individual client accounts.

creditsReviewer.thisReportAllowsYouTo: This report allows you to review all the credits issued to clients between 2 dates you specify.
creditsReviewer.noCreditsFoundForThis: No credits found for this period.

customerRetention.thisReportCalculatesAndProvides: This report shows the average lifetime of products, services, addons and domains: the number of days between the registration date and the termination date. Averages are grouped by product and billing cycle, and shown both in days and in years and months active.
customerRetention.includeActiveProductsServicesAssuming: Include Active Products & Services (Assuming active will end Next Due Date) in Calculation of Average Retention Time

directDebit.thisReportDisplaysAllUnpaid: This report displays all unpaid invoices assigned to the Direct Debit payment method and the associated bank account details stored for their owners ready for processing.

diskUsage.thisReportShowsTheDisk: This report shows the Disk Space & Bandwidth Usage Statistics for hosting accounts.
diskUsage.diskSpaceUsageStatsLast: Disk Space Usage Stats Last Updated at {value}
diskUsage.noDataYetClickUpdate: No data yet. Click Update Now to fetch it from the servers.
diskUsage.noData: No data found. Click Update Now to fetch stats from your hosting servers.

domainRenewalEmails.thisReportCanBeUsed: This report can be used to generate a custom export of the Domain Renewal Reminder Emails.

domainsReport.thisReportCanBeUsed: This report can be used to generate a custom export of domains by applying up to 5 filters. CSV Export is available via the Tools menu to the right.

incomeByProduct.thisReportGivesABreakdown: This report gives a breakdown per product/service of income paid in a given month.

incomeForecast.incomePerMonthWithTrailingWindows: Income received per month, with the trailing quarter, half year and year to date.

invoicesReport.thisReportCanBeUsed: This report can be used to generate a custom export of invoices by applying up to 5 filters.

monthlyOrders.thisReportGivesABreakdown: This report gives the units ordered of each product in a month: one per order line, on pending and accepted orders.

monthlyTransactions.thisReportProvidesASummary: This report provides a summary of daily pay transactions for a given month. The Amount Out figure includes both expenditure transactions and refunds.
monthlyTransactions.noTransactionsFoundForThis: No transactions found for this month.

newCustomers.monthlyNewSignupsAndOrder: Monthly new signups and order activity

productSuspensions.thisReportAllowsYouTo: This report allows you to review all suspended products and the reasons specified for their suspensions.

salesTax.thisReportShowsSalesTax: This report shows sales tax liability for the selected period.
salesTax.noInvoicesFoundForThis: No invoices found for this period.
salesTax.thisReportExcludesInvoicesThat: This report excludes invoices that affect a client's credit balance since this income will be counted and reported when it is applied to invoices for products/services.

servicesReport.thisReportCanBeUsed: This report can be used to generate a custom export of services by applying up to 5 filters. CSV Export is available via the Tools menu to the right.

sslMonitoring.displaysAListOfDomains: Displays a list of domains with their SSL status, if available.

supportTicketsReport.thisReportShowsABreakdown: This report shows a breakdown of support tickets dealt with per admin for a given month.

ticketFeedbackComments.thisReportAllowsYouTo: This report allows you to review feedback comments submitted by customers.

ticketFeedbackScores.thisReportProvidesASummary: This report provides a summary of scores received on a per staff member basis for a given date range.

ticketRatingsReviewer.thisReportIsShowingAll: This report is showing all 0-ticket replies rated 1 between the selected date range for review.

ticketTags.thisReportProvidesAnOverview: This report provides an overview of ticket tags assigned to tickets for a given date range.

topClients.thisReportShowsThe10: This report shows the 10 clients with the highest net invoice income: payments less refunds and fees. Credit top-ups are not income.

transactionsReport.thisReportCanBeUsed: This report can be used to generate a custom export of transactions by applying up to 5 filters.

vatMoss.thisReportProvidesTheInformation: This report provides the information needed to complete a VATMOSS return. Please check with your tax authority to confirm how you can upload your settlement data into the MOSS portal.
vatMoss.ifACountryDoesNot: * If a country does not appear in the report, then no VAT was collected from customers in that country during the period selected.

common.convertedToBaseCurrency: Amounts are in {currency}, converted from each invoice currency at the configured rates.
